Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients

Peel the oranges using a sharp knife, ensuring all the pith is removed. Slice as thinly as possible and arrange over a dinner plate. Sprinkle with the demerara sugar followed by the Grand Marnier and set aside. Incorporate 3 whole orange, 1 tbs demerara sugar, 2 tbs grand marnier, and 1 1/3 cup christmas pudding smoothly until evenly distributed.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Prep and measure orange first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

2

Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins

Crumble the Christmas pudding into large pieces and scatter over the bottom of a trifle bowl. Lift the oranges onto the pudding in a layer and pour over any juices. Incorporate 2 1/4 cup custard, 1 1/8 cup mascarpone, 1 1/8 cup double cream, 1 handful flaked almonds, and 1 grated dark chocolate smoothly until evenly distributed.

3

Dip & Coat Evenly

Beat the mascarpone until smooth, then stir in the custard. Spoon the mixture over the top of the oranges. Whisk steadily around the bottom and corners of the pan until glossy, thickened, and smooth enough to coat the back of a spoon.

4

Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy

Lightly whip the cream and spoon over the custard. Sprinkle with the flaked almonds and grated chocolate. You can make this a day in advance if you like, chill until ready to serve.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ac_unit

Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES348 kcal
SERVINGS4
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep christmas pudding trifle in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
